title: Replace Google authentication with admin-controlled username/password system

requirements.summary: Remove all Internet Identity and Google authentication dependencies from the frontend
acceptanceCriteria: Internet Identity provider is removed from main.tsx
useInternetIdentity hook is no longer used in any components
AuthClient dependencies are removed from the codebase
No references to Internet Identity remain in authentication flow

file_operations.description: Remove InternetIdentityProvider wrapper from the app root, leaving only QueryClientProvider and RouterProvider
Remove all references to useInternetIdentity hook and Internet Identity authentication flows
Delete the useInternetIdentity hook as it is no longer needed for username/password authentication

requirements.summary: Implement traditional username/password login form on LoginPage replacing Google sign-in
acceptanceCriteria: LoginPage displays username/ID input field
LoginPage displays password input field with obscured text
Submit button is present and functional
Dark mode styling is maintained consistent with current design
Form validation prevents empty submissions

file_operations.description: Replace the 'Sign in with Google' button with a traditional login form containing username/ID input, password input with type='password', and submit button. Maintain the dark mode styling with the existing layout structure. Add form validation to prevent empty submissions. Call the useAuth hook's login method with username and password on form submission.

requirements.summary: Create admin-only account creation interface with navigation menu integration
acceptanceCriteria: New navigation menu item visible only to admins
Account creation page includes username/ID input field
Password input field is present with visibility toggle
Role dropdown includes Admin, Teacher, Staff, and Student options
Name input field is included
Form submission calls backend createUser function
Success message displays after account creation
Form validation prevents duplicate usernames

file_operations.description: Create a new page component for admin-only account creation with form fields for username/ID (text input), password (with visibility toggle button), role selection (dropdown with options: Admin, Teacher, Staff, Student matching backend UserRole enum), and name (text input). Include form validation to prevent empty fields and duplicate usernames. Call the backend registerUser function on form submission and display success/error messages using toast notifications. Wrap the component with AdminGuard to restrict access.

Add a new navigation menu item 'Account Creation' or 'Manage Accounts' that links to /accounts route. Display this menu item only when the user has admin role using the isAdmin flag from useAuth hook. Place it in the navigation menu after the Subjects link.

Register the new /accounts route in the router configuration, importing and rendering the AccountCreationPage component. Ensure the route is protected and only accessible to authenticated admin users.

requirements.summary: Update useAuth hook to manage username/password authentication state
acceptanceCriteria: useAuth hook no longer depends on Internet Identity
Hook provides login function accepting username and password
Hook provides logout function that clears authentication state
Authentication state persists in browser storage
Hook returns current user profile and role information
isAuthenticated and isAdmin flags are correctly computed

file_operations.description: Rewrite the useAuth hook to remove Internet Identity dependencies. Implement login function that accepts username and password parameters, calls the backend authenticate function to obtain a session token, and stores the token in sessionStorage or localStorage. Implement logout function that calls backend logout with the token and clears all stored authentication state. Fetch user profile using the backend getUserByToken function with the stored token. Return isAuthenticated (based on token presence and validity), isAdmin (based on user role being 'admin'), user profile, login, and logout methods. Handle token persistence across page refreshes by checking stored token on hook initialization.

Update query hooks that depend on authentication to use the session token from useAuth instead of Internet Identity principal. Ensure getCallerUserProfile and related queries work with the new authentication mechanism. Update mutation handlers to include the session token in backend calls where required.

requirements.summary: Update useActor hook to initialize backend actor with session-based authentication
acceptanceCriteria: useActor no longer depends on Internet Identity
Actor initialization uses session token or authentication state
Backend calls include authentication credentials
Actor invalidates queries on authentication state changes

file_operations.description: Remove Internet Identity dependencies from the useActor hook. Modify actor initialization to work with session token authentication instead of Internet Identity principal. Remove the admin initialization logic that depends on getAdminToken since authentication is now handled via username/password. Ensure the actor is recreated when authentication state changes (login/logout). Update the hook to invalidate dependent queries when the actor instance changes.

requirements.summary: Remove ProfileSetupModal component as profiles are now admin-created
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileSetupModal component is removed from the codebase
App.tsx no longer displays the profile setup modal
User profiles are fully populated upon account creation
No first-time setup flow is required for new users

file_operations.description: Delete the ProfileSetupModal component since user profiles will be created by admins during account creation with all necessary information

Remove all references to ProfileSetupModal component including imports, state management, and rendering logic. Remove the profile setup check since users will have complete profiles upon account creation by admins.
